notes: Four distinct interaction episodes are visible: two separate driver-door cycles, followed by one hood cycle and one rear-hatch cycle. The initial and intervening camera surveys were not counted.
scene_description: A user walks around a parked blue Toyota Supra in an outdoor parking lot, opening and closing the driver-side door twice, then the front hood, then the rear hatch.
